description: The Gunn filter set at Apache Point Observatory provides intermediate-band g, r, i, and z filters implementing the Gunn-Thuan photometric system for instruments at the ARC 3.5-meter telescope.
facility_description: The ARC 3.5-meter Telescope is an optical and infrared telescope at Apache Point Observatory (APO) in the Sacramento Mountains of New Mexico, owned and operated by the Astrophysical Research Consortium.
notes: Gunn-Thuan g, r, i, z filters in the APO filter pool. Transmission scans are published on the APO filter server without an open redistribution licence.
